# Epistemic: measured (scheduler job-trace records from Shanghai AI Laboratory Kalos A100 cluster

#   gpu_num: integer [GPUs] — Number of GPUs requested per scheduled job
#   jobs: integer [jobs] — Total submitted GPU jobs at this request size
#   job_share: number [ratio] — Fraction of all submitted GPU jobs on 0-1 scale
#   gpu_seconds: integer [GPU-s] — Total allocated GPU-seconds across all terminal states
#   gpu_time_share: number [ratio] — Fraction of cluster GPU-seconds consumed on 0-1 scale
#   gpu_seconds_completed: integer [GPU-s] — Allocated GPU-seconds for jobs finishing in completed state
#   gpu_seconds_failed: integer [GPU-s] — Allocated GPU-seconds for jobs terminating in failed state
#   gpu_seconds_canceled: integer [GPU-s] — Allocated GPU-seconds for jobs ending in canceled state
